claims.statement: Runner IP note repeats NOTE markup and warns dynamically assigned shared IPs may be flagged due to unrelated activity; linked troubleshooting is not fully reviewed by this reference.

Hosted dynamic shared IP ranges appear in Meta API actions/actions_macos; unrelated tenant activity may influence third-party reputation. GitHub does not control list accuracy/freshness; Meta ranges help verify membership, not prove traffic benign. Microsoft-owned security concerns route to MSRC, with no external report submitted.
Label-settings gear is a UI step, not label mutation authority or complete label procedure.
Runner name may collide across repository and organization runners within one run; name alone is insufficient unique target identity.
Runner OS values are Linux, Windows or macOS, preserving exact case; actual runtime and architecture remain unobserved.
Runner temporary directory is emptied at job start/end except files the runner account lacks permission to delete. Cleanup intention is not guaranteed isolation or proof of sensitive-file removal.
Tool-cache path contains preinstalled hosted tools, with separate image inventory reference; path presence is not complete tool/version validation.
Service unavailability discards triggered workflow if not queued within30minutes; example31minutes not processed. Triggered/queued/executed are distinct, not guaranteed eventual execution.
Hosted hosts file redirects various mining/malicious domains to localhost, with example names; selected blocking is not exhaustive network security or policy authority to mutate hosts.
Scheduled events can delay at high load, notably hour boundaries, and queued jobs can be dropped. Scheduling off-boundary reduces likelihood but is not guaranteed delivery or verified recurrence.

Public fork schedules default disabled; public repository schedules auto-disable after60days without activity. Auto-disable may occur; private repository behavior is not implied by the stated public case.
Shared-action download receives scoped read-only installation token expiring after1hour. This is not GITHUB_TOKEN's distinct lifetime or actual observed credential.
Conditional custom-role UI may omit secret/variable tabs by permission; owners or users with both managers see both. Missing tab is not proof secrets absent or authorization to expose them.

Organization secrets share across repository workflows and centralized updates affect all users of that secret. Shared update is a broad impact requiring scoped authority and actual propagation verification.
Used secrets are automatically redacted in job logs, but intentionally printing secrets should be avoided. Redaction is not blanket safety for transformed values, artifacts or exported contexts.

GHEC/GHES group names must be unique across organization/enterprise visible scope; duplicates warn and ambiguous workflows fail. Rename or org/organization/ent/enterprise prefixes resolve scope; neither automatic rename nor assumed unique runner names follows. Prefix example include separately unresolved.
Selecting a larger runner for editing is navigation only, not authorization for subsequent settings changes.

Enterprise self-hosted creation uses navigation includes, conditional New runner/New self-hosted runner labels and shared configure fragment. No included configuration body implicitly reviewed, token generated or runner installed.
Self-hosted runner application connects machine to GitHub; software connectivity alone is not trusted isolation, successful job pickup or authorized installation.
Assigning existing self-hosted label uses shared gear settings then Find or create a label selection. Parent runner identity and actual assignment remain unverified.
